name: Kisantu

queries.result: First-party discovery found the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs directory of land/cadastral districts, which lists Kisantu under Kongo-Central, and the ministry's official land-research service. No public Kisantu parcel map or anonymous ID-plus-geometry endpoint was identified.

queries.query: Kisantu RDC cadastre parcelles carte officielle registre foncier
queries.result: La recherche en français a confirmé la circonscription foncière de Kisantu dans la province du Kongo-Central sur le site officiel du Ministère des Affaires Foncières. Le service officiel décrit une recherche formelle dans les registres, mais aucune couche publique de parcelles avec identifiant et géométrie n'a été exposée. Une page officielle du recensement confirme aussi des travaux de cartographie à Kisantu, sans fournir de parcelles cadastrales.

registryCustodian.name: Circonscription foncière de Kisantu / Ministère des Affaires Foncières, RDC
registryCustodian.scope: Local land and cadastral district for Kisantu in Kongo-Central, evidenced by the ministry's official directory. The ministry's formal research service routes requests to the competent cadastral/land-title offices.

service.name: Ministère des Affaires Foncières RDC public information and service portal
service.viewerConfiguration: The current public Next.js directory renders 143 land/cadastral districts and lists Kisantu under Kongo-Central. The official research form exposes administrative lookup fields for province, circonscription, commune/territory and parcel/file references, but it is a submitted research workflow and not a public parcel geometry service. The BIC public site advertises cadastral data only for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu, not Kongo-Central.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Anonymous official directory loaded. It lists Kisantu under Kongo-Central as a land/cadastral district. No parcel geometry, native parcel ID field, schema, or CRS was present. Current JavaScript/HTML was inspected; no public map/API endpoint was exposed.

Anonymous official land-research form loaded. It requires requester identity and supporting documents for a formal search, so no submission was attempted. The page exposes no anonymous parcel feature service and no safe geometry response.

Official public-service description loaded. It states that cadastral and land-register consultation is performed by the competent officials after a formal request; it is procedural prose, not a machine-readable parcel layer.
Official census article loaded and confirms cartographic data-collection application work in Kisantu. It provides no cadastral parcel IDs or polygons.

Public BIC landing page loaded. Its stated available coverage is Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; Kisantu is in Kongo-Central, so this was not treated as a Kisantu service. The current JavaScript bundle was inspected and no request was made to its database because the advertised geographic scope excludes the city.
